lahore.p: Lahore, the capital of Punjab and Pakistan's second-largest city, is one of the busiest departure points for Umrah and Hajj in the country. With a deep religious heritage and a population in the millions, tens of thousands of Lahoris travel to Makkah and Madinah every year — from first-time young pilgrims to elderly parents making the journey of a lifetime. Al Bari Travel & Tours coordinates the full trip for Lahore families: Saudi visa, flights, hotels near the Haram, and group departures.

Lahore is served by Allama Iqbal International Airport, one of Pakistan's principal gateways. Pilgrims from Lahore enjoy some of the best flight options in the country — direct services to Jeddah and Madinah on Saudia, flynas, and Pakistan International Airlines, plus frequent one-stop connections through Dubai, Doha, and Abu Dhabi. Because Lahore has direct international departures, most Umrah travellers reach the holy cities quickly, without long domestic connections.

You don't need to cross the city or take time off work to arrange your trip. From anywhere in Lahore — Model Town, Johar Town, Cantt, or the Walled City — you simply share your documents on WhatsApp, and your dedicated contact handles the visa, ticketing, and hotel booking end to end. Confirmation reaches your phone, with everything in writing.

karachi-central.p: Karachi, Pakistan's largest city and economic capital, sends more travellers abroad than anywhere else in the country. Its diverse, hard-working population includes lifelong residents and families from every province, and demand for Umrah and Hajj runs year-round. Al Bari Travel & Tours serves Karachi pilgrims across all districts — Central, East, South, West, Malir, and Korangi — with complete, transparent packages and honest guidance for first-time travellers.

Karachi is served by Jinnah International Airport, Pakistan's largest and best-connected airport. Pilgrims here have the widest choice of carriers and schedules — direct flights to Jeddah and Madinah on Saudia, flynas, PIA, and airblue, plus extensive Gulf connections on Emirates, Qatar Airways, and Etihad. This choice means better fares and flexible departure dates, especially outside peak season.

karachi-central.h: Booking from Karachi, the easy way
karachi-central.p: Whether you are in Gulshan, DHA, North Nazimabad, or Landhi, there is no need to visit an office. Send your passport details on WhatsApp and your Umrah or Hajj is arranged for you — visa, flights, and hotels near the Haram — with a clear written breakdown and no hidden costs.

faisalabad.p: Faisalabad — Pakistan's third-largest city and the heart of its textile industry — is home to a large, hard-working population with strong family and religious ties. Many Faisalabad families save for years to perform Umrah together, and a significant number of the city's residents also work in the Gulf, making the holy journey a regular part of community life. Al Bari Travel & Tours arranges complete, budget-friendly Umrah and Hajj packages for Faisalabad pilgrims.

Faisalabad is served by Faisalabad International Airport, which offers direct and connecting flights to Saudi Arabia and the Gulf, including seasonal Umrah services and regular routes via the major hubs. When a direct flight isn't available for your dates, we route you smoothly through Lahore or Islamabad, so pilgrims from Faisalabad and nearby Jhang, Chiniot, and Toba Tek Singh travel with minimal hassle.

From Madina Town to Peoples Colony, there's no need to travel for your booking. Share your documents on WhatsApp and your dedicated contact prepares everything — Saudi visa, tickets, and hotels near the Haram — with honest, written pricing and support at every step.

multan.p: Multan, the ancient 'City of Saints' and the gateway to southern Punjab, has one of the strongest spiritual traditions in Pakistan. Pilgrimage is woven into the culture here, and demand for Umrah and Hajj is high across the city and the surrounding districts of Khanewal, Lodhran, and Vehari. Al Bari Travel & Tours coordinates the full journey for Multan families, with packages for every budget and dedicated guidance for first-time pilgrims.

Multan is fortunate to have Multan International Airport, which operates direct Umrah flights to Jeddah and Madinah on Saudia and flynas, alongside regular Gulf connections. This means pilgrims from Multan and all of southern Punjab can often fly straight to the holy cities without travelling to Lahore or Karachi first — a real saving in time, cost, and comfort, especially for elderly travellers.

multan.h: Booking from Multan, the easy way
multan.p: Wherever you are in Multan — Cantt, Gulgasht, or the old city — you can arrange your entire trip from home. Send your passport details on WhatsApp, and your Umrah or Hajj is handled end to end, with clear written pricing and no surprises.

sialkot.h: Umrah, Hajj & Work Travel from Sialkot
sialkot.p: Sialkot is one of Pakistan's most internationally connected cities — a global export hub for surgical instruments, sports goods, and leather, with one of the largest overseas-working populations in the country. That means Sialkot families travel constantly, both for Umrah and Hajj and to visit relatives working in the Gulf and Europe. Al Bari Travel & Tours serves Sialkot with pilgrimage packages, visit visas, and honest travel guidance.

Sialkot is served by Sialkot International Airport — Pakistan's first privately owned international airport — with direct flights to Jeddah and Madinah for Umrah, plus strong connections to the Gulf and Europe. For pilgrims and overseas workers across Sialkot, Narowal, and Gujrat, this local international gateway makes travel far more convenient than routing through Lahore.

From the city centre to Daska and Pasrur, there's no need to visit an office. Share your documents on WhatsApp and your trip — Umrah, Hajj, or a family visit visa — is arranged for you, with everything confirmed in writing.

gujrat.h: Umrah, Hajj & Family Visas from Gujrat
gujrat.p: Gujrat is famous across Pakistan for its enormous overseas community — few districts have sent as many people abroad, particularly to Europe and the Gulf. With remittances shaping daily life, Gujrat families are constant travellers: performing Umrah and Hajj, and applying for visit visas to reunite with relatives working overseas. Al Bari Travel & Tours understands this community and serves it with honest, complete travel support.

Gujrat does not have its own airport, but it sits close to Sialkot International Airport — usually around an hour away — which offers direct Umrah flights to Jeddah and Madinah as well as Gulf and European connections. Lahore's Allama Iqbal International is the alternative gateway. We arrange the full routing so travellers from Gujrat, Kharian, and Sarai Alamgir depart with the fewest connections possible.

gujrat.p: Whether you are in Gujrat city, Kharian, or Lalamusa, you can arrange everything from home. Send your details on WhatsApp — for Umrah, Hajj, or a family visit visa — and receive a clear, written plan with no hidden costs.

hyderabad.p: Hyderabad, the second-largest city of Sindh and the historic gateway to the province's interior, has a large and devout population for whom Umrah and Hajj are cherished journeys. Serving both the city and the surrounding districts of Matiari, Tando Allahyar, and Jamshoro, Al Bari Travel & Tours arranges complete packages with hotels near the Haram, Saudi visa processing, and dedicated support for first-time and elderly pilgrims.

Pilgrims from Hyderabad typically fly from Karachi's Jinnah International Airport, about two to three hours away by the M-9 motorway — Pakistan's largest airport, with the widest choice of direct flights to Jeddah and Madinah and the best fares. We coordinate your travel to the airport and your onward flights on one plan, so the journey from Hyderabad is smooth from start to finish.

From Latifabad to Qasimabad, there's no need to travel to arrange your trip. Share your documents on WhatsApp and your Umrah or Hajj is prepared for you — visa, flights, and hotels — with honest pricing you can see in writing.

sukkur.p: Sukkur is the commercial hub of upper Sindh and a natural centre for the many surrounding districts — Ghotki, Khairpur, Shikarpur, and beyond. Its families hold pilgrimage close, and demand for Umrah and Hajj is steady throughout the year. Al Bari Travel & Tours serves the Sukkur region with complete, transparent packages and patient guidance for those travelling to the holy cities for the first time.

sukkur.h: Flying from Sukkur (via Karachi for Saudi Arabia)
sukkur.p: Sukkur has its own airport with domestic flights, so most pilgrims fly to Karachi's Jinnah International Airport and take their international flight to Jeddah or Madinah from there — a routing we book together on one itinerary, so there is no gap between flights. For upper Sindh travellers, this is the fastest and most comfortable way to reach the Haram.

abbottabad.p: Abbottabad, the green heart of the Hazara region, is known for its schools, its cool climate, and a community with strong faith and a large presence working abroad. Umrah and Hajj are treasured journeys here, and many Hazara families travel regularly. Al Bari Travel & Tours serves Abbottabad and the wider Hazara districts of Haripur, Mansehra, and Battagram with honest, complete pilgrimage packages.

Pilgrims from Abbottabad usually depart from Islamabad International Airport, roughly two hours away along the motorway — one of Pakistan's newest and best-connected airports, with direct flights to Jeddah and Madinah on Saudia, flynas, and PIA. We arrange your travel to Islamabad and your onward flights as a single plan, so the journey from Hazara is seamless.

From Abbottabad city to Havelian and Mansehra, you can arrange your trip entirely from home. Share your documents on WhatsApp and your Umrah or Hajj is handled end to end, with clear written pricing and no hidden charges.

quetta.p: Quetta, the capital of Balochistan, serves a vast province and a devout population for whom the pilgrimage to Makkah and Madinah holds deep meaning. Distances in Balochistan are large, which makes trusted, well-organised travel support especially important. Al Bari Travel & Tours coordinates the full journey for Quetta families — Saudi visa, flights, hotels near the Haram, and group departures — with honest guidance at every step.

Quetta is served by Quetta International Airport, which offers connections toward Saudi Arabia and the Gulf. Where a direct service isn't available for your dates, we route you smoothly through Karachi — Pakistan's largest hub — for the onward flight to Jeddah or Madinah, booked together on one itinerary so pilgrims from Quetta and across Balochistan travel with the fewest connections possible.
